name: k8s_pvc
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this persistent volume claim.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the persistent volume claim. Must be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase alphanumeric and '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric).

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this claim to a cloud provider account. Inherited from the resource group.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this persistent volume claim belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group (EKS cluster) this claim belongs to. Required: the backend does not derive it, and resources created without it cannot be loaded by env/RG-scoped lookups.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the claim is created in. Must reference an existing, fully provisioned namespace in the same resource group.

attributes.name: access_modes
attributes.description: Access modes for the volume. One or more of: ReadWriteOnce, ReadOnlyMany, ReadWriteMany, ReadWriteOncePod.

attributes.name: storage
attributes.description: Requested storage size as a Kubernetes quantity, e.g. "10Gi". May be increased on update (volume expansion) but not decreased.

attributes.name: storage_class_name
attributes.description: Name of the StorageClass to provision from. Must be a storage class available in the cluster; when omitted the cluster's default StorageClass is used.

attributes.name: volume_mode
attributes.description: How the volume is consumed: Filesystem (default) or Block.

attributes.name: volume_name
attributes.description: Name of a specific PersistentVolume to bind to (static binding). When omitted it is assigned by the cluster once the claim is bound.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the persistent volume claim. Send-only: the server injects its own duplocloud.ai/* labels, so this value is not read back to avoid spurious drift.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the persistent volume claim. Send-only (not read back).

failureStates.WaitingForApproval: provisioning is waiting for manual approval, which Terraform cannot provide
